# BUILD PAC CLASSIFICATION INPUT

```{r}
library(digest)
library(uuid)
```

```{r}
contributions_agg$Recipient.Committee.ID <- as.character(contributions_agg$Recipient.Committee.ID)
prepped$Recipient.Committee.ID <- as.character(prepped$Recipient.Committee.ID)

hash_id <- function(keys, prefix) {
  paste0(prefix, "_", substr(digest::digest(paste(sort(unique(keys)), collapse = "||"), algo = "xxhash32"), 1, 16))
}

# get entity_group for each $5k+ individual/org contributor
over_5k_indiv <- over_5k_tagged %>%
  filter(contributor_type == "individual_or_org" | (contributor_type == "major_donor_ie_committee" & is_resolvable == TRUE))

direct_for_classification <- over_5k_indiv %>%
  inner_join(
    prepped %>% filter(!is_pac, !is_fed_pac, !is_candidate_pac),
    by = c("parent_pac_id" = "Recipient.Committee.ID", "entity_group")
  ) %>%
  mutate(entity_type = if_else(
    sapply(Contributor.Name, is_individual), "individual", "organization"
  ))

# load uuid map from 0802 (canonical_name -> entity_uuid)
# so PAC contributors get entity_id_normalized consistent with direct-contributor entity_id_normalized.
if (!exists("canonical_uuid_map")) {
  cumap_path <- "08_outputs/canonical_uuid_map.csv"
  if (file.exists(cumap_path)) {
    canonical_uuid_map <- read.csv(cumap_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    cat(sprintf("Loaded canonical_uuid_map: %d canonical names\n", nrow(canonical_uuid_map)))
  } else {
    canonical_uuid_map <- NULL
    cat("Warning: canonical_uuid_map.csv not found — entity_id_normalized will be NA for all PAC contributors. Run 0802 first.\n")
  }
}

# format to match 0801 classification_input schema
# entity_id: hash-based id preserved for downstream compatibility.
# entity_id_normalized: UUID from canonical_uuid_map via Normalized column — consistent with 0802's
#   direct-contributor entity_id_normalized; NA if the contributor has no Normalized mapping.
pac_classification_input <- direct_for_classification %>%
  mutate(
    Recipient.Committee.ID = parent_pac_id,
    entity_id = if_else(
      !is.na(std_contributor_id),
      paste0("id_", std_contributor_id),
      sapply(Contributor.Name, function(n) hash_id(n, "indiv"))
    ),
    unit_key = paste(entity_id,
                     coalesce(processed_employer_name, ""),
                     coalesce(processed_occupation, ""),
                     sep = "||"),
    classification_unit_id = sapply(unit_key, function(k) hash_id(k, "unit")),
    contribution_uuid      = replicate(n(), uuid::UUIDgenerate())
  ) %>%
  select(-unit_key)

if (!is.null(canonical_uuid_map)) {
  cumap_for_join <- canonical_uuid_map %>% select(canonical_name, entity_id_normalized = entity_uuid)
  duped_names <- cumap_for_join %>% group_by(canonical_name) %>% filter(n() > 1) %>% pull(canonical_name) %>% unique()
  if (length(duped_names) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("WARNING: %d canonical_name(s) appear multiple times in canonical_uuid_map — using first match per name\n", length(duped_names)))
    cumap_for_join <- cumap_for_join %>% group_by(canonical_name) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup()
  }
  pac_classification_input <- pac_classification_input %>%
    mutate(Normalized_clean = str_squish(coalesce(Normalized, ""))) %>%
    left_join(cumap_for_join, by = c("Normalized_clean" = "canonical_name")) %>%
    select(-Normalized_clean)
} else {
  pac_classification_input <- pac_classification_input %>%
    mutate(entity_id_normalized = NA_character_)
}

cat(sprintf("PAC contributor entity_id_normalized: %d / %d rows matched via Normalized\n",
            sum(!is.na(pac_classification_input$entity_id_normalized)),
            nrow(pac_classification_input)))

# exclude contributors to PACs already classified as Candidates/Political Parties -
# those PACs full amounts are assigned that category directly in match_pac_classifications.
# also exclude any PAC identified as a candidate committee by name pattern that
# isn't yet in pac_manual_review just in case
candidates_pp_pac_ids <- pac_manual_review %>%
  filter(!is.na(pac_id), is_candidates_pp) %>%
  pull(pac_id) %>% as.character()

candidate_pac_ids_by_name <- prepped %>%
  filter(is_candidate_pac, !is.na(std_contributor_id)) %>%
  pull(std_contributor_id) %>%
  unique()

all_candidate_pac_ids <- unique(c(candidates_pp_pac_ids, candidate_pac_ids_by_name))

pac_classification_input <- pac_classification_input %>%
  filter(!parent_pac_id %in% all_candidate_pac_ids)

```


### Match back UUIDs from prior classifications

```{r}
pad_zip <- function(z) {
  z <- trimws(as.character(z))
  needs_pad <- !is.na(z) & z != "" & str_detect(z, "^[0-9]+$") & nchar(z) < 5
  z[needs_pad] <- paste0(strrep("0", 5 - nchar(z[needs_pad])), z[needs_pad])
  substr(z, 1, 5)
}

normalize_missing <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  if_else(x %in% c("", "N/A", "NA", "None", "n/a") | is.na(x), "N/A", x)
}
```

```{r}
already_classified_files <- list.files(
  "08_inputs",
  pattern = "^already_classified_contributions_.*\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(already_classified_files) > 0) {
  most_recent <- already_classified_files[which.max(file.mtime(already_classified_files))]
  cat(sprintf("Loading %s for PAC contributor UUID match-back\n", basename(most_recent)))

  categorized_pac <- read_csv(most_recent, col_types = cols(.default = "c")) %>%
    mutate(Amount = as.numeric(Amount))

  # PAC rows in older already-classified files have Recipient.Committee.ID = NA because
  # pac_classification_input used parent_pac_id (not Recipient.Committee.ID) as the key.
  # Recover parent_pac_id via the prior pac_classification_input.csv output, joining on uuid.
  prior_pac_input_path <- "08_outputs/pac_classification_input.csv"
  if (any(is.na(categorized_pac$Recipient.Committee.ID)) && file.exists(prior_pac_input_path)) {
    prior_pac_input <- read_csv(prior_pac_input_path, col_types = cols(.default = "c")) %>%
      select(uuid, parent_pac_id) %>%
      mutate(parent_pac_id = sub("\\.0$", "", trimws(parent_pac_id)))
    categorized_pac <- categorized_pac %>%
      left_join(prior_pac_input, by = "uuid") %>%
      mutate(Recipient.Committee.ID = coalesce(
        na_if(trimws(Recipient.Committee.ID), ""),
        na_if(trimws(parent_pac_id), "")
      )) %>%
      select(-parent_pac_id)
    cat(sprintf("  Recovered Recipient.Committee.ID for %d PAC rows via prior pac_classification_input.csv\n",
                sum(!is.na(categorized_pac$Recipient.Committee.ID))))
  }

  # strip trailing .0 
  categorized_pac <- categorized_pac %>%
    mutate(Recipient.Committee.ID = sub("\\.0+$", "", trimws(coalesce(Recipient.Committee.ID, ""))))
  categorized_pac$Recipient.Committee.ID[categorized_pac$Recipient.Committee.ID == ""] <- NA_character_

  # sanity check 
  cat(sprintf("  %d rows still have Recipient.Committee.ID = NA after recovery (will be dropped)\n",
              sum(is.na(categorized_pac$Recipient.Committee.ID))))

  # check (b): every (Recipient.Committee.ID, Recipient.Name) combo in categorized_pac
  # should be a known combo in contributions_full. An unknown combo means the wrong ID
  # was propagated to a recipient that doesn't appear with that ID in the current data.
  known_id_name_combos <- contributions_full %>%
    filter(!is.na(Recipient.Committee.ID), !is.na(Recipient.Name)) %>%
    distinct(Recipient.Committee.ID, Recipient.Name)

  id_name_check <- categorized_pac %>%
    filter(!is.na(Recipient.Committee.ID), !is.na(Recipient.Name)) %>%
    distinct(Recipient.Committee.ID, Recipient.Name) %>%
    anti_join(known_id_name_combos, by = c("Recipient.Committee.ID", "Recipient.Name")) %>%
    arrange(Recipient.Committee.ID)

  cat(sprintf("  (b) ID→name consistency: %d (ID, name) combos not found in contributions_full — investigate id_name_check\n",
              nrow(id_name_check)))
  if (nrow(id_name_check) > 0) print(id_name_check)


  categorized_pac <- categorized_pac %>%
    
    filter(!is.na(Recipient.Committee.ID), Recipient.Committee.ID != "") %>%
    mutate(
      legacy_match_id = make_row_hash(
        Contributor.Name, Contributor.ID, Amount, Recipient.Committee.ID,
        Contributor.City, normalize_missing(Contributor.Employer),
        normalize_missing(Contributor.Occupation), pad_zip(Contributor.Zip.Code),
        Start.Date
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(legacy_match_id) %>%
    mutate(dup_rank = row_number()) %>%
    ungroup()

  cat(sprintf("  %d previously classified PAC contribution rows available for match-back\n",
              nrow(categorized_pac)))
} else {
  categorized_pac <- NULL
  cat("No already_classified_contributions file found — all PAC contributor UUIDs will be fresh.\n")
}
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(categorized_pac)) {
  pac_classification_input <- pac_classification_input %>%
    mutate(
      legacy_match_id = make_row_hash(
        Contributor.Name, Contributor.ID, as.numeric(Amount), parent_pac_id,
        Contributor.City, normalize_missing(Contributor.Employer),
        normalize_missing(Contributor.Occupation), pad_zip(Contributor.Zip.Code),
        Start.Date
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(legacy_match_id) %>%
    mutate(dup_rank = row_number()) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    left_join(
      categorized_pac %>% select(legacy_match_id, dup_rank, prior_uuid = uuid),
      by = c("legacy_match_id", "dup_rank")
    ) %>%
    mutate(uuid = coalesce(prior_uuid, contribution_uuid)) %>%
    select(-dup_rank, -prior_uuid)

  n_matched <- sum(pac_classification_input$uuid != pac_classification_input$contribution_uuid,
                   na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("PAC contributor UUID match-back: %d / %d matched from prior classifications\n",
              n_matched, nrow(pac_classification_input)))

  # check (a): for matched rows, verify key fields are consistent between pac_classification_input
  # and the categorized_pac row they matched to (catching any hash collision or wrong recovery).
  if (n_matched > 0) {
    matched_pci <- pac_classification_input %>%
      filter(uuid != contribution_uuid) %>%
      select(uuid, pci_name = Contributor.Name, pci_amount = Amount,
             pci_pac_id = parent_pac_id, pci_date = Start.Date, pci_contrib_id = Contributor.ID)

    field_check <- matched_pci %>%
      left_join(
        categorized_pac %>% select(uuid,
          cat_name = Contributor.Name, cat_amount = Amount,
          cat_pac_id = Recipient.Committee.ID, cat_date = Start.Date,
          cat_contrib_id = Contributor.ID
        ),
        by = "uuid"
      ) %>%
      filter(
        (!is.na(cat_name) & pci_name != cat_name) |
        (!is.na(cat_amount) & abs(as.numeric(pci_amount) - as.numeric(cat_amount)) > 0.01) |
        (!is.na(cat_pac_id) & pci_pac_id != cat_pac_id) |
        (!is.na(cat_date) & as.character(pci_date) != as.character(cat_date))
      )
    cat(sprintf("  (a) UUID field consistency: %d / %d matched rows have field mismatches (expect 0) — investigate field_check\n",
                nrow(field_check), n_matched))
  }
} else {
  pac_classification_input <- pac_classification_input %>%
    mutate(uuid = contribution_uuid)
}
```

### save files to use later

```{r}
# carry entity_id_normalized from pac_input.csv for seed PACs
# x (pac_input.csv) rows have entity_id (the UUID from 0802's Normalized-name
# entity resolution). One seed PAC -> one UUID; flag conflicts where FILER_ID
# maps to more than one distinct UUID (indicates a name-map gap).
seed_entity_ids <- x %>%
  filter(!is.na(FILER_ID) & trimws(as.character(FILER_ID)) != "") %>%
  mutate(FILER_ID = as.character(FILER_ID)) %>%
  group_by(FILER_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    entity_id_normalized = {
      ids <- na.omit(unique(trimws(entity_id)))
      if (length(ids) == 1) ids else NA_character_
    },
    n_entity_ids = n_distinct(na.omit(trimws(entity_id))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(pac_id = FILER_ID)

n_conflict <- sum(seed_entity_ids$n_entity_ids > 1, na.rm = TRUE)
if (n_conflict > 0)
  cat(sprintf("Warning: %d seed PAC(s) map to >1 entity_id_normalized in pac_input.csv — entity_id_normalized set to NA for those. Fix name map upstream.\n", n_conflict))

pac_classifiability <- pac_classifiability %>%
  left_join(seed_entity_ids %>% select(pac_id, entity_id_normalized), by = "pac_id")

cat(sprintf("entity_id_normalized from pac_input.csv: %d / %d PACs matched\n",
            sum(!is.na(pac_classifiability$entity_id_normalized)), nrow(pac_classifiability)))
```

```{r}
# entity_id_normalized for non-seed PACs 
# seeds get their UUID from pac_input.csv 
# non-seeds: look up via canonical_uuid_map 
# then pac_entity_id_registry.csv (persistent store keyed by FILER_ID),
# then generate a new UUID and append to the registry

PAC_REGISTRY_PATH <- "08_inputs/pac_entity_id_registry.csv"

if (file.exists(PAC_REGISTRY_PATH)) {
  pac_entity_id_registry <- read.csv(PAC_REGISTRY_PATH, stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                                     colClasses = c(pac_id = "character"))
} else {
  pac_entity_id_registry <- tibble(pac_id = character(), entity_uuid = character(),
                                    added_date = character())
}

# check that each FILER_ID must map to exactly one Normalized name.
# multiple Normalized values for the same PAC means the name map is inconsistent.
pac_normalized_check <- contributions_agg %>%
  filter(!is.na(std_contributor_id), std_contributor_id != "",
         !is.na(Normalized), str_squish(Normalized) != "") %>%
  mutate(Normalized = str_squish(Normalized)) %>%
  group_by(std_contributor_id) %>%
  summarise(n_normalized = n_distinct(Normalized),
            normalized_values = paste(sort(unique(Normalized)), collapse = " | "),
            .groups = "drop")

pac_name_conflicts <- pac_normalized_check %>% filter(n_normalized > 1)
if (nrow(pac_name_conflicts) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("Note: %d PAC(s) have multiple Normalized names (unresolved name variants). Normalized-name lookup skipped for those; FILER_ID registry or fresh UUID used instead.\n",
              nrow(pac_name_conflicts)))
}

# PACs with multiple Normalized names get pac_normalized = NA — they skip the
# canonical_uuid_map lookup and fall through to the FILER_ID registry or a fresh UUID.
pac_normalized_names <- pac_normalized_check %>%
  mutate(pac_normalized = if_else(n_normalized > 1, NA_character_, normalized_values)) %>%
  select(pac_id = std_contributor_id, pac_normalized)

non_seed_pacs <- pac_classifiability %>%
  filter(is.na(entity_id_normalized)) %>%
  select(pac_id) %>%
  left_join(pac_normalized_names, by = "pac_id") %>%
  # conflicted seed PACs (>1 entity_id in x) skip canonical_uuid_map —
  # their Normalized name is ambiguous; the FILER_ID registry is the stable fallback.
  mutate(pac_normalized = if_else(
    pac_id %in% (seed_entity_ids %>% filter(n_entity_ids > 1) %>% pull(pac_id)),
    NA_character_, pac_normalized
  ))

# step 1 : canonical_uuid_map lookup
if (!is.null(canonical_uuid_map) && nrow(non_seed_pacs) > 0) {
  non_seed_pacs <- non_seed_pacs %>%
    left_join(canonical_uuid_map %>% select(canonical_name, entity_uuid),
              by = c("pac_normalized" = "canonical_name"))
} else {
  non_seed_pacs <- non_seed_pacs %>% mutate(entity_uuid = NA_character_)
}

# flag if any PAC matched multiple rows in canonical_uuid_map (indicates duplicate
# canonical_name entries in the map, which should never happen given distinct() at build time)
multi_uuid_match <- non_seed_pacs %>%
  filter(!is.na(entity_uuid)) %>%
  group_by(pac_id) %>%
  filter(n() > 1) %>%
  ungroup()
if (nrow(multi_uuid_match) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("WARNING: %d PAC(s) matched multiple entries in canonical_uuid_map — collapsing to NA (will fall through to registry)\n",
              n_distinct(multi_uuid_match$pac_id)))
  print(multi_uuid_match)
  non_seed_pacs <- non_seed_pacs %>%
    mutate(entity_uuid = if_else(pac_id %in% unique(multi_uuid_match$pac_id), NA_character_, entity_uuid)) %>%
    distinct(pac_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

n_from_map <- sum(!is.na(non_seed_pacs$entity_uuid))

# step 2: persistent registry lookup by FILER_ID (stable across runs)
non_seed_pacs <- non_seed_pacs %>%
  left_join(pac_entity_id_registry %>% select(pac_id, registry_uuid = entity_uuid),
            by = "pac_id") %>%
  mutate(entity_uuid = coalesce(entity_uuid, registry_uuid)) %>%
  select(-registry_uuid)
n_from_registry <- sum(!is.na(non_seed_pacs$entity_uuid)) - n_from_map

# step 3: generate new UUIDs for still-unmatched PACs; persist to registry
needs_new <- is.na(non_seed_pacs$entity_uuid)
if (any(needs_new)) {
  non_seed_pacs$entity_uuid[needs_new] <- uuid::UUIDgenerate(n = sum(needs_new))

  new_entries <- non_seed_pacs[needs_new, c("pac_id", "entity_uuid")] %>%
    mutate(added_date = as.character(Sys.Date())) %>%
    filter(!pac_id %in% pac_entity_id_registry$pac_id)

  if (nrow(new_entries) > 0) {
    write.csv(bind_rows(pac_entity_id_registry, new_entries),
              PAC_REGISTRY_PATH, row.names = FALSE)
    cat(sprintf("Appended %d new PAC entity IDs to pac_entity_id_registry.csv\n",
                nrow(new_entries)))
  }
}

cat(sprintf(
  "Non-seed PAC entity_id_normalized: %d via canonical_uuid_map, %d via registry, %d newly generated\n",
  n_from_map, n_from_registry, sum(needs_new)
))

pac_classifiability <- pac_classifiability %>%
  left_join(non_seed_pacs %>% select(pac_id, non_seed_uuid = entity_uuid), by = "pac_id") %>%
  mutate(entity_id_normalized = coalesce(entity_id_normalized, non_seed_uuid)) %>%
  select(-non_seed_uuid)

cat(sprintf("entity_id_normalized total coverage: %d / %d PACs\n",
            sum(!is.na(pac_classifiability$entity_id_normalized)), nrow(pac_classifiability)))
```

```{r}
write_csv(pac_classification_input,    paste0("08_outputs/pac_classification_input_", today, ".csv"))
write_csv(over_5k_tagged,              paste0("08_outputs/over_5k_tagged_", today, ".csv"))
write_csv(pac_classifiability,         paste0("08_outputs/pac_classifiability_", today, ".csv"))

# save the traversal order — needed to replay topological sort for industry breakdown
write_csv(tibble(pac_id = ordered_pacs, order = seq_along(ordered_pacs)),
          paste0("08_outputs/pac_traversal_order_", today, ".csv"))
write_csv(tibble(pac_id = stuck_pacs),  paste0("08_outputs/pac_stuck_pacs_", today, ".csv"))

```


**NOTE**: 
UUID conflicts can arise when a ballot measure committee also contributes to
another PAC, causing it to be traversed in the PAC graph. Its incoming contributions
then appear in both paths (direct via 0802, pac via 0803). The dedup chunk below
resolves conflicts by keeping the direct row, but the upstream fix is to exclude
0802 target committees from pac_summaries in 0802b so they are never traversed.

```{r}
# combine with 0801's classification_input (run 0801 first so the file exists)
existing <- read_csv("08_outputs/classification_input_09-07-26.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
existing$Cycle <- as.integer(existing$Cycle)
existing$Amount <- as.numeric(existing$Amount)
existing$has_pac_language <- as.logical(existing$has_pac_language)
existing$rowid <- as.character(existing$rowid)
existing$row_id <- as.integer(existing$row_id)
existing$contributor_path <- "direct"

pac_classification_input$rowid <- as.character(pac_classification_input$rowid)
pac_classification_input$entity_type_ambiguous <- as.character(pac_classification_input$entity_type_ambiguous)
pac_classification_input$is_fed_pac <- as.character(pac_classification_input$is_fed_pac)
pac_classification_input$contributor_path <- "pac"

combined_classification_input <- bind_rows(existing, pac_classification_input)

# verigy
stopifnot(nrow(combined_classification_input) == nrow(existing) + nrow(pac_classification_input))
cat(sprintf("direct: %d rows | pac: %d rows | combined: %d rows\n",
            nrow(existing), nrow(pac_classification_input), nrow(combined_classification_input)))

# detect UUID conflicts — do NOT deduplicate automatically here; review uuid_conflicts first,
# then run the dedup chunk
uuid_conflicts <- combined_classification_input %>%
  group_by(uuid) %>% filter(n() > 1) %>% ungroup() %>% arrange(uuid)
cat(sprintf("UUID conflicts: %d rows across %d uuids appear in both paths — review uuid_conflicts before deduplicating\n",
            nrow(uuid_conflicts), n_distinct(uuid_conflicts$uuid)))
if (nrow(uuid_conflicts) > 0) {
  print(uuid_conflicts %>% select(uuid, contributor_path, Contributor.Name,
                                  Recipient.Committee.ID, Recipient.Name, Amount, parent_pac_id))
}
cat(sprintf("uuid uniqueness: %d distinct uuids across %d rows\n",
            n_distinct(combined_classification_input$uuid), nrow(combined_classification_input)))
```


```{r}
# run this chunk only after reviewing uuid_conflicts above
# keeps the direct row for each conflicted UUID
if (nrow(uuid_conflicts) > 0) {
  combined_classification_input <- combined_classification_input %>%
    arrange(uuid, contributor_path) %>%  # "direct" sorts before "pac"
    distinct(uuid, .keep_all = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("After dedup: %d rows (%d removed)\n",
              nrow(combined_classification_input), nrow(uuid_conflicts) / 2))
} else {
  cat("No conflicts to resolve.\n")
}
```

         Recipient.Committee.ID, Recipient.Name, Amount, parent_pac_id) %>%
